purchases.title: Purchase invoices
purchases.subtitle: What suppliers billed us. Open one for its amounts, lines and scanned documents.
purchases.newSubtitle: Record a supplier's invoice as it was received: its number, dates, amounts and lines. The goods receipt it bills can be attached once the supplier is chosen.
purchases.detailSubtitle: A supplier's invoice as recorded: its amounts, payment, lines and the goods receipt it bills.
purchases.editSubtitle: Every field is written on save, so a blank clears it. The scanned documents are kept as they are.
purchases.deleteBody: The invoice and its {count, plural, =0 {lines} one {# line} other {# lines}} are deleted permanently. The goods receipt it bills is not affected.

form.noReceipt: No goods receipt for this supplier
form.receiptHint: The delivery this invoice bills, if it was recorded. Only receipts from the chosen supplier are offered.

period.label: Issued
period.inRange: {count, plural, one {# invoice} other {# invoices}} in this period

row.dueIn: in {count, plural, one {# day} other {# days}}
row.late: {count, plural, one {# day} other {# days}} late

empty.title: No purchase invoices
empty.text: Nothing matches these filters at once.

sales.title: Sales invoices
sales.subtitle: What we billed clients, and the drafts waiting to be issued. Create one here, or from an invoiceable order's page.
sales.detailSubtitle: An invoice to a client: its amounts, payment, lines, and the order and shipment it belongs to. A draft can still be edited; an issued invoice is final.
sales.emptyMessage: No sales invoices match these filters.
sales.draftBanner: Draft — not yet numbered. It receives the next F{yy} number when issued, and freezes.
sales.currencyRequired: A currency is required to issue the invoice.
sales.issueBody: The invoice receives the next number of {year} and can no longer be edited.
sales.unsavedSavedFirst: Your unsaved changes are saved first.
sales.saveBeforeRefresh: Save the draft before refreshing quantities from packaging.
sales.discardBody: The draft is deleted, and any order it bills returns to invoiceable. Nothing has been numbered yet, so nothing is lost but the edits. The note is written to the order's history.

hints.noPackagingPlanned: Nothing packed yet — the quantity falls back to the {planned} planned parcels
hints.noPackaging: Nothing packed yet and no parcel count planned
hints.priceChanged: The order's price is now {price} — adjust the unit price if the invoice should follow it

sales.newSubtitle: Bill a client for anything that is not a job order — a service, a one-off sale, a re-invoiced cost. Type the lines yourself; the draft takes its number when you issue it.
sales.previewError: The preview could not be drawn.
sales.previewHint: The invoice as it will print, redrawn as you type. Nothing is saved until you save the draft.
sales.pdfHint: Printed from the invoice as it was issued, then stored: every later view serves the same file.

row.late: {count, plural, one {# day} other {# days}} late
